We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from make_1_lvl2-template_search-1 to the molecule. We have the mapped_rxn and template_id from that input: mapped_rxn is given, template_id 12345. We need to apply that template retrosynthetically to the target molecule (initial_molecule). Use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles (the target) and template_id. The target SMILES is given with atom mapping: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

We need to apply template 12345. Let's call apply_template.
